name: PRESSURE early closed-candle follow-through confirmation
purpose: Test whether post-signal movement confirmation can reduce large negative tails without selecting thresholds on the 2023-08 diagnostic month.

causality.rule: candidate scanner uses only close_time < decision_time; follow-through decisions use only bars closed by the gate time
causality.entry_repricing: No retroactive entry. A failed gate exits the already-open paper position at the gate close; a passed gate retains the predeclared fixed-gross-0.50 path.

locked_gates.pass: gross target already hit, or the 30-minute closed-bar return is greater than 0
locked_gates.rationale: Require immediate positive price continuation; no indicator level is read statically.

locked_gates.pass: gross target already hit, or close return > 0 AND post-entry 15m quote-volume sum >= prior-60m 15m quote-volume sum
locked_gates.rationale: Require price continuation supported by non-declining participation.

locked_gates.pass: gross target already hit, or first-hour MFE >= 0.25% AND close return >= -0.25% AND taker-buy quote share >= 0.50
locked_gates.rationale: Require expansion plus price retention plus buyer participation; all are measured as a closed-candle sequence.

requirements: The same gate must improve net_total_pct and expectancy_pct versus baseline in both D1 and D2.
Pooled expectancy_pct after 0.20% cost must be greater than 0.
Pooled profit_factor must be greater than 1.0.
Worst-trade loss magnitude must improve by at least 40% versus baseline.
At least 70% of baseline target-first events must be preserved.
No period, symbol, or setup kind may supply more than 60% of pooled positive P&L.
decision_gate.failure: Reject the gate family; do not retune these horizons or thresholds under a new name.
decision_gate.success: Freeze exactly one simplest passing gate, then test it without changes in 2024 Calibration. Do not modify Clear System.py yet.

action_budget.basis: run 36293311039 used 14.18 runner-minutes for one 30-day month
action_budget.rule: Do not start if implementation exceeds this ceiling or cannot reuse a single hash-verified data fetch across both periods.
